C-41.Name: Brand themes Paper and Ink, Auto/Light/Dark switch, and a theme set of light/dark pairs
C-41.Summary: Today the default themes are a green Light and a blue Dark from MarkText, and the 33 themes are 10 light and 23 dark, with several near-duplicates (Rosé Pine Moon, Tokyo Night Storm, Ayu Mirage). Replace the defaults with brand themes Paper and Ink (icon colours: paper, ink, marker yellow), add an Auto/Light/Dark button in the title bar like the Avenex site, and reorganise the set into families that each have a light and a dark member, so Auto can switch within the chosen family.

Problem.Description: User 2026-10-15: «пересмотреть дефолтные темы (особенно эту зеленую или синюю) … ближе к фирменному стилю»; «тему как на сайте авенекс (те же иконки в тулбаре, авто, день, ночь) — режима авто не хватает»; «остальные тоже проверил переработал, может что-то подсократил (в том числе до чётного кол-ва светлых и тёмных инверсионных)».

Goals.R-1: Paper (light) and Ink (dark) themes from the 2026-10-15 preview (https://claude.ai/artifact/42rx58VdD82sax7ub3KHGK): ochre accent on Paper, marker accent on Ink, links in text colour with a marker underline, marker selection and highlight, semantic callout colours kept. They become the defaults for new installs.
Goals.R-2: Title-bar theme button cycles Auto → Light → Dark with the Avenex icons (half disc, sun, moon) and a tooltip; Auto follows macOS appearance. Backed by the existing followSystemTheme / lightModeTheme / darkModeTheme preferences (found in the C-38 N2 audit).
Goals.R-3: Theme set as families with a light and a dark member; the picker shows families, the button picks the member. Proposed 12 families (24 themes): Paper/Ink (new), Rosé Pine Dawn/Rosé Pine, Catppuccin Latte/Mocha, Solarized Light/Dark, Gruvbox Light/Dark, Everforest Light/Dark, Tokyo Night Light/Tokyo Night, Ayu Light/Ayu Dark, One Light (new)/One Dark, Alucard (new, official Dracula light)/Dracula, Nord Light (new)/Nord, Kanagawa Lotus (new)/Kanagawa, Graphite/Graphite Dark (new), Ulysses/Ulysses Dark (new) — 14 families, 28 themes (user 2026-10-15: keep Graphite and Ulysses, «оставить»). Every theme reviewed for contrast (WCAG AA body text) and for the same structure as Paper/Ink.
Goals.R-4: Dropped themes migrate: light → Paper, dark → Ink, rose-pine-moon → rose-pine, tokyo-night-storm → tokyo-night, ayu-mirage → ayu-dark, monokai-pro, nightfox, material-dark, palenight, horizon-dark, synthwave-84, cyberdream, oxocarbon-dark → the nearest family by accent/background (mapping table in the plan). A stored value that no longer exists never leaves the app unthemed.

T1.Title: Paper + Ink themes as defaults; Auto/Light/Dark title-bar button

T2.Title: Family model, picker by family, migrations

T3.Title: New members (One Light, Alucard, Nord Light, Kanagawa Lotus, Graphite Dark, Ulysses Dark) and a contrast pass over all 28

C-41.Dependencies: C-38 N3 (Settings redesign shows the theme picker by family); store screenshots and the app preview use only shipped themes.

Constraints.Constraint: Theme variables are applied inline on documentElement (util/theme.js addThemeStyle) — new themes use the same mechanism.
No user loses their choice silently: migrations are explicit and tested.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New install opens in Paper (or Ink when macOS is dark, Auto); the button cycles Auto/Light/Dark and Auto follows a live macOS appearance change; every family has both members; every removed theme id migrates.

AffectedAreas.M-011: themes, util/theme.js, titleBar theme button, preferences defaults and migration, theme picker

C-41.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for the button cycle, Auto resolution and migrations; WebKit screenshot matrix of every theme on one document; contrast check script.

Approval.ApprovedBy: user (2026-10-15): «по двум темам тоже нра» (Paper/Ink) and the Avenex-style Auto/Light/Dark button; asked to review and trim the rest into light/dark pairs
Approval.ApprovalScope: T1 approved. T2/T3 approved in direction (pairs, trimming); family list confirmed 2026-10-15 (14 families; Graphite and Ulysses kept with new dark members).
